unit_vocabulary.meaning: n. 传统
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: It is a Chinese tradition to eat dumplings during the Spring Festival.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 春节吃饺子是中国的传统。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 词根 trad (交付、传递)，一代代传下来形成“传统”。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: adj. 传统的
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: More and more young people are learning traditional Chinese medicine.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 越来越多的年轻人正在学习中医学（传统中国医学）。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: tradition (传统) + -al (形容词后缀) = 传统的。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: v. 翻译
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Can you help me translate this English article into Chinese?
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 你能帮我把这篇英语文章翻译成中文吗？
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: trans- (跨越、转换) + late (带，源自拉丁语词根) = 把一种语言带过界变成另一种语言，即“翻译”。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `v.` 运输, 运送
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Transport [Table Header]
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 字根记忆：trans（转移）+ port（港口、运送）→ 跨港口运送。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: n. 运输；交通工具
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Convenient transportation makes traveling much easier than before.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 便利的交通使出行比以前容易多了。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: transport (运输) + -ation (名词后缀) = 运输 / 交通工具。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: adj. 难以置信的, 惊人的, 难以相信的
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: It is unbelievable that he solved the difficult math problem in one minute.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 真令人难以置信，他在一分钟内就解开了这道数学难题。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: un- (不) + believe (相信) + -able (能……的) = 难以置信的。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: adj. 不舒服的, 不自在的, 棘手的
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: I felt a bit uncomfortable wearing these new shoes.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 穿着这双新鞋，我感到有点不舒服。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: un- (不) + comfortable (舒服的) = 不舒服的。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `adj.` 地下的, 秘密的, 非法的, 暗中的 `adv.` 在地下, 隐蔽地 `n.` 地铁, 地下铁路系统
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: It goes underground.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: under（在……下面）+ ground（地面）= 地下的。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: v. 在(词语等下)画线；强调, 突出
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Please underline the key words while reading the text.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 请在阅读课文时把关键词画线标出。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: under (在……下面) + line (线) = 在下面画线/强调。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: adj. 水下的, 用于水下的 adv. 在水下
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Some amazing animals can live deep underwater without light.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 一些神奇的动物可以在没有光的深水下生存。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: under (在……下面) + water (水) = 水下的。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: n. 内衣, 衬衣
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Remember to pack enough clean underwear for the camp.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 记得为露营带够干净的内衣。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: under (在……下面) + wear (穿戴的衣物) = 穿在里面的内衣。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: adj. 出乎意料的, 想不到的
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Winning the first prize was an unexpected surprise for me.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 赢得一等奖对我来说是个意料之外的惊喜。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: un- (不) + expected (预料到的) = 出乎意料的。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: adj. 未经勘探的；未被探索的
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The deep forest remained unexplored for centuries.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 这片深林几个世纪以来一直未被探索过。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: un- (不) + explored (探索过的) = 未经探索的。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: adj. 不熟悉的, 陌生的, 不认识的
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Walking into the new school, I felt a bit lost in the unfamiliar surroundings.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 走进新学校，我在陌生的环境中感到有点迷茫。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: un- (不) + familiar (熟悉的) = 不熟悉的。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: adj. 难忘的, 难以忘怀的
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Our trip to Beijing last summer will always be an unforgettable experience.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 我们去年夏天的北京之行将永远是一次难忘的经历。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: un- (不) + forget (忘记) + -able (能……的) = 不能忘记的/难忘的。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: adv. 不幸地, 遗憾地, 可惜地
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Unfortunately, it started to rain heavily just as we were going out.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 不幸的是，我们刚出门天就下起了大雨。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: un- (不) + fortunate (幸运的) + -ly (副词后缀) = 不幸地。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: adj. 不友好的, 有敌意的, 冷漠的
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Though the stray dog looked fierce, it wasn't unfriendly to us.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 虽然这只流浪狗看起来很凶，但对我们并不不友好。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: un- (不) + friendly (友好的) = 不友好的。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: adj. 不健康的, 不良的, 有害的, 虚弱的
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Eating too much junk food is unhealthy for growing teenagers.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 吃太多垃圾食品对正在长身体的青少年不健康。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: un- (不) + healthy (健康的) = 不健康的。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: adj. 不愉快的, 不舒服的, 不客气的
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: We had an unpleasant argument about who should wash the dishes.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 我们为谁该洗碗发生了一次不愉快的争吵。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: un- (不) + pleasant (愉快的) = 不愉快的。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: n. 小提琴手
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The talented young violinist played a beautiful song at the concert.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 这位才华横溢的年轻小提琴手在音乐会上演奏了一首动听的曲子。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: violin (小提琴) + -ist (演奏某乐器的人) = 小提琴手。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 词汇；词汇量；词汇表
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: For me, vocabulary is my biggest problem.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 词根记忆：voc-（声音，言语）+ -abulary → 所有的词语汇聚在一起 → 词汇。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: adj. 自愿的；志愿的
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Many students signed up for voluntary work in the community library.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 许多学生报名参加社区图书馆的志愿工作。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 来自 volunteer (志愿者)，变形容词为 voluntary (自愿的)。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 义务工作者；志愿者 `v.` 自愿做；义务做
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Now, my family often volunteer together.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 谐音：哇(vol)+轮(un)+替(teer) -> 哇，大家轮流替换去做志愿者。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 废水
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: How was your school trip to the wastewater plant?
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: waste（浪费/废物）+ water（水）= 废水

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 瀑布
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: amazing waterfalls, colourful lakes, beautiful mountains
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 【教材补充词汇】组合词：water（水）+ fall（落下）→ 水落下来就是瀑布。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: adv. 向西
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The ship sailed westwards across the blue ocean.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 轮船向西航行，穿过蔚蓝的大海。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: west (西方) + -wards (向……方向) = 向西。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 轮椅
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: It can help people in wheelchairs use the phone.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: wheel(轮子) + chair(椅子) = 轮椅

unit_vocabulary.meaning: n. 摔跤运动
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Wrestling is one of the oldest sports in the Olympic Games.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 摔跤是奥运会中最古老的运动项目之一。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: wrest (摔跤/搏斗) + -ing (名词后缀，表示运动项目) = 摔跤运动（w不发音）。
